payload.rationale: Selected from 8 validation-only trials. Refined tiny_cnn building on the best round-1 result (0.9762). Depth reduced to 3 (max valid for 28x28) to avoid over-downsampling while retaining 3 conv-pool stages. Hidden widened from 64 to 96 for ~50% more channel capacity without overfitting at 90K samples. Dropout relaxed to 0.15 since the wider channels provide implicit regularization. Added contrast augmentation alongside hflip+brightness for stronger photometric diversity. Patience increased to 3 (from 2) because the round-1 curve was still rising at epoch 3, indicating the model needs more epochs to converge. Cosine schedule with eta_min=0 ensures the LR decays smoothly over the 6-epoch budget. Class weighting retained for the 1.63x imbalance.
